name: Gabriel Broliato
text: a friend recommended Mf projects solutions, he conducted for us a snag list report. Really good service, the company is really quick and organized, the snagger pointed and warned us about every single important thing in the house and recommend further services to keep the house in a better standard. If you expect fair price and good service you cannot choose another company.
